description: This file contains utility functions for loading and processing example configurations in the Superset project, including reading YAML files, normalizing schemas, and importing example data.

methods.name: _normalize_dataset_schema
methods.description: Replaces 'schema: main' with 'schema: null' in YAML content for portability.

methods.name: _read_file_if_exists
methods.description: Reads file content if it exists, returns None otherwise.

methods.name: _load_shared_configs
methods.description: Loads shared database and metadata configs from the _shared directory.

methods.name: _should_skip_directory
methods.description: Determines if a directory should be skipped during traversal based on its name.

methods.name: _load_datasets_from_folder
methods.description: Loads dataset configuration files from a specified folder.

methods.name: _load_charts_from_folder
methods.description: Loads chart configuration files from a specified folder.

methods.name: _load_example_contents
methods.description: Loads all configs (datasets, dashboards, charts) from a single example directory.

methods.name: load_examples_from_configs
methods.description: Loads all examples from the directory structure and runs import command.

methods.name: load_contents
methods.description: Traverses example directories and loads YAML configs into import structure.

methods.name: load_configs_from_directory
methods.description: Loads all YAML config files from a specified directory and runs import command.
